requirements.statement: Original challenge evidence remains immutable
requirements.acceptance: All 132 extracted file hashes and the ZIP hash match inventory

requirements.statement: Every material decision fact carries evidence provenance
requirements.acceptance: No P0 projection/decision material fact lacks evidence IDs

requirements.statement: Occurred and recorded time remain distinct
requirements.acceptance: Known-at replay is stable under late evidence

requirements.statement: Unknown is distinct from false or satisfied
requirements.acceptance: Missing/contradictory evidence returns UNKNOWN and blocks progression

requirements.statement: Authority derives from authenticated server policy
requirements.acceptance: Body-supplied role cannot authorize a decision

requirements.statement: Recommendation approval and execution are separate
requirements.acceptance: Recommendation cannot emit or apply authority events

requirements.statement: Audit events are attributable and tamper-evident
requirements.acceptance: Hash-chain verification passes and mutation is detected

requirements.statement: Ambiguous identifiers never create identity links
requirements.acceptance: Conflict opens an owned case and link remains absent

requirements.statement: Identity approval binds exact proposal and evidence
requirements.acceptance: Authorized decision applies once and changed payload is rejected

requirements.statement: Milestone readiness evaluates consent authorization site and identity
requirements.acceptance: Missing expired or conflicting prerequisite blocks or returns unknown

requirements.statement: Idempotency key binds command type scope and canonical payload
requirements.acceptance: Replay returns stored result and changed payload conflicts

requirements.statement: Ambiguous external outcome is reconciled before retry
requirements.acceptance: Timeout enters OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and no blind retry occurs

requirements.statement: Compensation is explicit and verified
requirements.acceptance: Partial effect cannot be silently treated as success or failure

requirements.statement: Only authorized Quality evidence establishes release
requirements.acceptance: MES ERP and AI cannot create PRODUCT_RELEASED

requirements.statement: QC deviation and thermal evidence remain explicit
requirements.acceptance: Missing or ambiguous disposition remains a blocker or unknown

requirements.statement: AI is optional and failure returns deterministic workflow
requirements.acceptance: Disabled outage or invalid output preserves deterministic context

requirements.statement: AI output is schema and evidence bounded
requirements.acceptance: Extra authority fields and unknown citations are rejected

requirements.statement: AI has no consequential tools
requirements.acceptance: No assistant interface exposes identity command release or clinical mutation

requirements.statement: Critical exceptions have owner status and history
requirements.acceptance: Every P0 exception is assigned and auditable

requirements.statement: Three POCs share application services and stable contracts
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end journey uses identity readiness command and quality services

requirements.statement: Deterministic projection meets local POC latency
requirements.acceptance: p95 <=250ms under fixed local benchmark

requirements.statement: Database backup restore and replay preserve state digests
requirements.acceptance: Restored digest equals pre-backup digest

requirements.statement: Commands decisions recommendations and cases are observable
requirements.acceptance: Metrics and correlation IDs exist for controlled operations

requirements.statement: Cross-scope access is denied
requirements.acceptance: Principal outside journey scope cannot read or mutate it

requirements.statement: Release is reproducible
requirements.acceptance: Manifest records version data schema and evaluation digests

requirements.statement: Original v2 evaluation patients remain read-only and source-located
requirements.acceptance: EVAL-001 through EVAL-006 show exact frozen patient assertions with file and row locators

requirements.statement: Hypothetical injects are not presented as recorded patient facts

requirements.statement: Human oversight resists automation bias

requirements.statement: Authorized users can safely override abstain and escalate
